parentFixture.reason: The frozen parent is a fingerprint of the boundary-projection trajectory on the canonical Apple M4 Max platform. On x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu the in-run trajectory converges to an independently valid 181.938 mm endpoint whose projection fingerprints as 51b77c0f23d9bb1d1efa2e9c24780e3f67732c87ba9a81c874df117a43c20b97, so without the fixture every nonzero mode skips before any experimental work. The engine's compiled-in frozen fingerprint, parent-depth, and dual-validation checks still gate the loaded fixture layout.

partialGate.definition: terminal comparator-best partial with strictly lower inactive grid area and no more inactive pieces than the control's terminal comparator-best, with best-ever objectives not regressing (declared in persistent-vacancy-population-design.md before these runs)

decision.mode7: retained-directional: out-of-beam archive revival preserves the elite basin through the terminal layers at +8 selected slots and +64 finalist rows of funded work; measured engine medians on this machine are statistically indistinguishable from control (mode 3 3629 ms, mode 7 3616 ms across two replays); it did not extend best-ever objectives
decision.mode8: retained-directional: the equal-slot swap variant reaches the same improved terminal state with the same funded slot and finalist quotas as control; realized downstream work naturally differs once trajectories diverge at the first revival. Preferred over mode 7 on funded-cost grounds pending a completion-capable lifecycle
honestLimits: neither arm completes 61/61, so no depth claim toward 154.44858 mm is made
best-ever objectives did not improve: the win is preservation of the terminal population under the ledger's established partial-gate form, not discovery of a new basin
single machine (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu); the canonical M4 gates, including the 6000 ms engine gate the elite screen already missed there, must be re-evaluated on that platform before promotion
decision.nextExperiment: the archive preserves but does not extend: successor generation from the revived elite reuses the same insertion/ejection operator that plateaued at 11 inactive pieces. The next causal variable is a materially different transition from archived states, for example bounded multi-piece remove/reinsert around the inactive pieces' blocker neighborhoods, or coupling the archive to a relocation-capable operator, with modes 7/8 as the control
